sentences.en: Now that there's artificial intelligence, your own intelligence is irrelevant.
sentences.zh: 现在有了人工智能，你自己的智力就无关紧要了。

sentences.en: My grandfather, being hard of hearing, often makes an irrelevant answer.
sentences.zh: 我爷爷听力不好，经常答非所问。

sentences.en: My name and my birthplace are irrelevant, my friend.
sentences.zh: 我的名字和出生地与这件事无关要紧。

senses.zh: 不相干的,不恰当,缺乏时代性的，落后于潮流的,牛头不对马嘴

mnemonic: 词根记忆：ir（不）+relevant（有关的）→无相关的
